decision.rationale: The prospectively changed single-case contract is build-qualified on a fresh source-disjoint development fold. Individual model or semantic failures will be measured through the governed no-action fallback, while identity, budget, ledger, hash, and gold-boundary failures remain execution-invalid. No architecture or engine is selected at build time.

limitations: This is build-only evidence and does not select an architecture or product model.
The fold uses synthetic policy-oracle cases and cannot establish real learner benefit.
GPT-5.6 Luna has no dated snapshot; exact returned identity remains mandatory during execution.
